hints: A base defends a pawn but nothing defends it.

items.explain: The pawn on e6 defends d5 and f5 and no pawn defends it, so it is the base of the centre. The pawn on b7 defends c6 and nothing defends it either. Attacking a base, for example with e3-e4 or b4-b5, is the usual way to undermine a chain; attacking the head is a different job (rule of thumb).
